what_happened: Job 20261103-055218-kj1t ("Add steward triage pass at the start of each drain", a retry) failed in planning, before any code was written. The planner stopped with error_max_budget_usd: it used up its USD budget cap and did not finish. No plan was kept, no acceptance criteria were reported unmet, no checks failed, and no findings were raised. Nothing was delivered or judged.
cause: This is a retry ("retry vq7x"), so the job's remaining budget was already reduced by the earlier attempt's planning spend. Nothing compares the remaining budget with the cost the planning stage needs, or with the combined stage caps, before a retry is dispatched. Planning has a hard USD cap, keeps no partial plan and has no hold or resume path. When the cap is hit, the whole planning spend is lost and the failure shows only as an error string. The request itself (a new drain-time triage pass) is also a wide change to a core flow. Nothing sizes it against the planning budget.
prevention: Before dispatching a retry, and at admission, check the job's remaining budget (cap minus all earlier attempts and planning spend) against the planning stage cap plus the producer and verifier caps. If it falls short, hold the job and show the shortfall. Do not start planning. Also have the planner write out its partial plan when it nears the cap, and treat error_max_budget_usd as a hold with a resume path, not a plain failure.
proposed_request: Make Athena check a job's remaining budget before it starts planning, on both first runs and retries. Outcome: before planning is dispatched, Athena compares the budget left (the job cap minus the spend of earlier attempts and planning) with the planning cap plus the producer and verifier caps. If the budget is too small, the job is held, not failed, and the message states the budget left, the amount needed and the command to raise the cap and resume. Acceptance: (1) a retry whose remaining budget is below the combined stage caps is held before any planning spend, with the shortfall shown; (2) a job with enough budget runs as before; (3) when the planner stops on error_max_budget_usd, the job is recorded as held for budget with any partial plan kept, and not as a plain failure; (4) a test covers each case, using a retry whose earlier attempt spent most of the cap. After this lands, re-queue "Add steward triage pass at the start of each drain" with a raised cap.
